prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A tidy bright bathroom and bedroom, a child washing hands with adult supervision. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Clean Day". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Bath time, brush the tooth.
Wash the hand and clean the room.
Wet hair beside the wall.
Dry the floor before the fall.
Hang the curtain, open the window.
Soft light, one good habit.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
